sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Liberal board is full.
Hitler is executed.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: Nobody. Any player could be lying to you.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Tell the truth: you are solving a puzzle.
Ask players to explain their votes and powers.
Slow the table down.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Fascist board is full.
Hitler is elected Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: The other Fascists and Hitler.
The Monarchist, who shows you a thumb.

sections.label: GOOD TO KNOW
items: You cannot be radicalised.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Claim to be a Liberal.
Spend your trust to make Hitler look trustworthy.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Fascist board is full.
You are elected Chancellor after 3 Fascist policies.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: Only the Fascist, when there is just one.
Otherwise nobody: show your thumb at setup.

sections.label: YOU MUST
items: Say that you are Hitler when executed, or when elected Chancellor after 3 Fascist policies.

sections.label: GOOD TO KNOW
items: A Bodyguard dies in your place, once.
You cannot be radicalised.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Communist board is full.
Hitler is executed (the Liberals win too).

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: The other Communists, from the start.
The Anarchist, who shows you a thumb.

sections.label: YOUR POWERS
items: Radicalisation and Congress: open your eyes with the Communists.
Capitalist hunt: before you execute a player as President, you may reveal your membership card. If you then execute the Capitalist, the Communists get an extra Radicalisation.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Communist board is full.
Hitler is executed (the Liberals win too).

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: Nobody. At setup, show your thumb to the Communists.
With just one other Communist, open your eyes with them.
Keep your eyes closed at Radicalisation and Congress.

sections.label: YOUR POWER
items: Assassination, once per game: after a policy is enacted and before the next election, reveal your Secret Role card and execute a player.

rulebook.title: The Anarchist
paragraphs: Wins if the Communists win. At setup the Anarchist only shows a thumb, so the Communists know them but not the other way round, unless there is just one other Communist.
Power: once per game, after a policy is enacted and before the next election, the Anarchist may reveal their role and assassinate a player.
rulebook.addWhen: your group knows the Communists well and wants a wild card.
rulebook.addWhenTable: your group knows the Communists well and wants a wild card.
rulebook.pitch: A hidden Communist with one assassination: after any policy, anyone can be shot.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Fascist board is full.
Hitler is executed.
Not when Hitler becomes Chancellor.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: Nobody. At setup, show your thumb to the Fascists.

sections.label: YOUR POWER
items: When Call Special Election is enacted, you may reveal yourself and become the next President.
The President who enacted it and you each name a Chancellor candidate.
Everyone gives their ballot card to one of them. Most cards wins. You break ties.

rulebook.title: The Monarchist
paragraphs: Wins if six Fascist policies are enacted or Hitler is executed, but not when Hitler is elected Chancellor. At setup the Monarchist only shows a thumb, so the Fascists (not Hitler) know them.

Power: when Special Election is enacted, the Monarchist may reveal their role and become the next President at once. The Monarchist and the President who enacted the policy each name a Chancellor candidate. Everyone hands their ballot card to the candidate they back. The one with the most cards becomes Chancellor, and the Monarchist breaks ties.
rulebook.pitch: A Fascist who wants the board, not Hitler. Splits the Fascist team and can seize the presidency at Special Election.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Fascist board is full.
Hitler is elected Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: The Fascists and Hitler: you open your eyes with the Fascists.

sections.label: YOUR POWER
items: The first time Hitler would be executed, reveal your Secret Role card.
You die instead, and Hitler lives.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Once you have saved Hitler, everyone knows who he is.
Push for a full Fascist board.

rulebook.title: The Bodyguard
paragraphs: Wins with the Fascists and opens their eyes with them. The first time Hitler would be executed, the Bodyguard dies instead. Hitler survives, but everyone now knows who he is, so the Fascists must win with policies.
rulebook.addWhen: Hitler is found and executed too often.
rulebook.addWhenTable: Hitler is found and executed too often.
rulebook.pitch: Dies in Hitler's place the first time he is shot, so one lucky execution no longer wins the game.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Fascist board is full.
Hitler is elected Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: The Fascists and Hitler: you open your eyes with the Fascists.

sections.label: YOUR POWER
items: Once per game, at any moment: reveal your Secret Role card and execute a player.
If that player is the Liberal Spy, the game ends right away and the Fascist team wins.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Be certain before you shoot.
A miss leaves the Liberal Spy free to talk.

rulebook.title: The Fascist Spy
paragraphs: Wins with the Fascists.
Power: once per game, at any moment, the Fascist Spy may reveal and execute a player. If it is the Liberal Spy, the Fascists win at once.
rulebook.addWhen: you want a hidden duel. Always add it together with the Liberal Spy.
rulebook.addWhenTable: you want a hidden duel. Always add it together with the Liberal Spy.
rulebook.pitch: Can shoot once at any moment. Hitting the Liberal Spy wins the game for the Fascists.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Liberal board is full.
Hitler is executed.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: Every Fascist except Hitler: at setup they show you their thumbs.

sections.label: DANGER
items: If a player of the Fascist team executes you, the game ends right away and the Fascists win.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Never say outright that you know the Fascists.
Steer the votes quietly.

rulebook.title: The Liberal Spy
paragraphs: Wins with the Liberals. At setup the Liberal Spy sees the Fascists' thumbs, so they know every Fascist except Hitler. If a player of the Fascist team executes the Liberal Spy, the Fascists win. The Liberal Spy must help without giving themselves away.
rulebook.addWhen: you want a hidden duel. Always add it together with the Fascist Spy.
rulebook.addWhenTable: you want a hidden duel. Always add it together with the Fascist Spy.
rulebook.pitch: Knows every Fascist except Hitler, but must stay hidden: if the Fascists shoot them, they win.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Liberal board is full.
Hitler is executed.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: The other Centrists: you open your eyes together at setup.

sections.label: GOOD TO KNOW
items: If you are radicalised, you join the Communists. The other Centrists are not told and may still trust you.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Wait before you reveal that you are Centrists.
Fascists will pretend to be Centrists.
The Communists will want to radicalise you.

rulebook.title: Centrists
paragraphs: Centrists are Liberals who know each other: they open their eyes together at setup. They hold Liberal cards, so they are targets for Radicalisation.
A radicalised Centrist joins the Communists, but the other Centrists are not told, so they may keep trusting them.
rulebook.addWhen: the game is big and the Liberals need a small group that trusts each other.
rulebook.addWhenTable: the game is big and the Liberals need a small group that trusts each other.
rulebook.pitch: Liberals who know each other from the start: a trusted core the others can build on.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The Liberal board is full.
Hitler is executed.

sections.label: TWO MEMBERSHIP CARDS
items: At Radicalisation, show the Fascist one. You are never converted.
At Investigate Loyalty, show the Liberal one. At Bugging, you choose.

sections.label: LOBBY CARD
items: At Radicalisation, give it to the player you trust most. They may vote three times with it, once.

sections.label: DANGER
items: A revealed Communist President who executes you earns them a Radicalisation.

rulebook.title: The Capitalist
paragraphs: Wins with the Liberals and can never be radicalised. The Capitalist holds two membership cards: the Fascist one is shown at Radicalisation, the Liberal one at Investigate Loyalty, and either one at Bugging.
Lobby card: during Radicalisation the Capitalist gives it to a trusted player, who may spend it once to vote three times.
Danger: a Communist President who reveals their membership card before an execution and then executes the Capitalist earns the Communists an extra Radicalisation.
rulebook.addWhen: Communist policies pass too quickly or Radicalisation is too easy.
rulebook.addWhenTable: Communist policies pass too quickly or Radicalisation is too easy.
rulebook.pitch: A Liberal who can never be radicalised and hands out a Lobby card worth three votes.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: You are executed. The game ends at once and only you win.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: Nobody.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Look suspicious, but not too obviously.
Every execution counts: by a President, Confession, the Anarchist or the Fascist Spy.
Never claim to be the Jester.

rulebook.title: The Jester
paragraphs: Holds a Fascist card. If the Jester is executed, the game ends and only the Jester wins. Every execution counts: by a President, Confession, the Anarchist or the Fascist Spy.
rulebook.pitch: Wins alone if executed, so every execution becomes a gamble.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The party on your Party Membership card wins.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: What that party knows: you open your eyes with it at setup.

sections.label: YOUR POWER
items: Once per game, reveal your Secret Role card and cast three votes in one election.
It stacks with the Lobby card.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Save your votes for the election that decides the game.
Revealing shows your role, never your party.

rulebook.title: The Propagandist
paragraphs: Belongs to the party on their membership card and wakes with it.
Power: once per game, the Propagandist may reveal and cast three votes in one election. It stacks with the Lobby card.
rulebook.pitch: Casts three votes once, enough to swing one election.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The party on your Party Membership card wins.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: What that party knows: you open your eyes with it at setup.

sections.label: YOUR POWER
items: Once per game, reveal your Secret Role card and look at the top two policies of the discard pile.
Afterwards you can never be nominated Chancellor.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Look right after a government you doubt.
Revealing shows your role, never your party.

rulebook.title: The Bureaucrat
paragraphs: Belongs to the party on their membership card.
Power: once per game, the Bureaucrat may reveal and look at the top two policies of the discard pile, but can never be nominated Chancellor afterwards.
rulebook.addWhen: Liberals are too often fooled about which policies were discarded.
rulebook.addWhenTable: Liberals are too often fooled about which policies were discarded.
rulebook.pitch: Looks at the top two discarded policies once, to catch a lying President or Chancellor.

sections.label: SETUP
items: You start with no membership card. At night, draw one from the spare deck: you join that party.

sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: The party you drew wins.

sections.label: YOUR POWER
items: When Bugging or Investigate Loyalty is enacted while you are President or Chancellor, you may reveal your Secret Role card and take the power over.
You alone choose the player. They secretly hand you their Secret Role card, not only their party.
At any other time you have no power.

rulebook.title: The Detective
paragraphs: Starts without a membership card. At the very start of the night script the Detective draws one from a spare deck of 2 Liberal, 1 Fascist and 1 Communist card, and joins that party.

Power: when Bugging or Investigate Loyalty is enacted while the Detective is President or Chancellor, the Detective may reveal their Secret Role card and take that power over. The Detective alone chooses the player, who secretly hands over their Secret Role card instead of their Party Membership card.
Outside those two moments the Detective has no power and plays like any member of their party.
rulebook.pitch: Joins a random party and turns Bugging or Investigate Loyalty into a look at the target's Secret Role card.
